commands.command:
set -eu
base=/srv/legacy2/relative-symlink-relocation
bundle=$base/bundle
awk -F '\t' 'NR>1 { if (NF != 2 || $1 == "" || $2 == "") { print "invalid manifest row " NR > "/dev/stderr"; exit 1 } print $1 "\t" $2 }' "$base/links.tsv" |
while IFS="$(printf '\t')" read -r link target; do
  case "$link:$target" in /*:*|*:/*) printf 'absolute manifest path rejected: %s -> %s\n' "$link" "$target" >&2; exit 1;; esac
  linkpath=$bundle/$link
  [ -L "$linkpath" ] || { printf 'not a symlink: %s\n' "$linkpath" >&2; exit 1; }
  linkdir=$(dirname "$linkpath")
  reltarget=$(realpath -m --relative-to="$linkdir" "$bundle/$target")
  ln -sfn "$reltarget" "$linkpath"
  printf 'repaired %s -> %s\n' "$linkpath" "$(readlink "$linkpath")"
done

set -eu
base=/srv/legacy2/relative-symlink-relocation
bundle=$base/bundle
printf '%s\n' '--- manifest-to-link verification ---'
awk 'NR>1 {print $1, $2}' "$base/links.tsv" |
while read -r link target extra; do
  [ -z "${extra:-}" ]
  p=$bundle/$link
  [ -L "$p" ]
  actual=$(readlink "$p")
  [ "${actual#/}" = "$actual" ]
  resolved=$(readlink -e "$p")
  expected=$(realpath -e "$bundle/$target")
  [ "$resolved" = "$expected" ]
  printf '%s -> %s ; resolved=%s ; expected=%s ; type=symlink\n' "$link" "$actual" "$resolved" "$expected"
done
printf '%s\n' '--- regular files after repair ---'
find "$bundle" -type f -exec sha256sum {} \; | sort
find "$bundle" -type f -exec stat -c '%a %U:%G %s %n' {} \; | sort
printf '%s\n' '--- report access through links ---'
printf 'current/report.txt: '; cat "$bundle/current/report.txt"
printf 'latest-report: '; cat "$bundle/latest-report"

commands.command:
set -eu
src=/srv/legacy2/relative-symlink-relocation/bundle
testroot=$(mktemp -d /tmp/bundle-relocation-test.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$testroot"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
mkdir -p "$testroot/another/location"
cp -a "$src" "$testroot/another/location/copied-bundle"
dst=$testroot/another/location/copied-bundle
printf 'relocated-copy=%s\n' "$dst"
for link in current latest-report; do
  [ -L "$dst/$link" ]
  target=$(readlink "$dst/$link")
  [ "${target#/}" = "$target" ]
  resolved=$(readlink -e "$dst/$link")
  case "$resolved" in "$dst"/*) :;; *) printf 'link escaped relocated bundle: %s\n' "$resolved" >&2; exit 1;; esac
  printf '%s -> %s ; resolves-within-copy=%s\n' "$link" "$target" "$resolved"
done
printf 'copied current/report.txt: '; cat "$dst/current/report.txt"
printf 'copied latest-report: '; cat "$dst/latest-report"
printf '%s\n' 'relocation-test=PASS'
rm -rf "$testroot"
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
commands.stdout:
relocated-copy=/tmp/bundle-relocation-test.m6AxOm/another/location/copied-bundle
current -> releases/two ; resolves-within-copy=/tmp/bundle-relocation-test.m6AxOm/another/location/copied-bundle/releases/two
latest-report -> releases/two/report.txt ; resolves-within-copy=/tmp/bundle-relocation-test.m6AxOm/another/location/copied-bundle/releases/two/report.txt
